title: I Applied to 59 Tech Jobs in 14 Days. Here's What Actually Happened
why_read: A personal job-search anecdote with some data tracking, relatable but offering little actual technical content.
analysis: This is a personal essay about applying to 59 tech jobs in 14 days, tracking the process with spreadsheets and timelines to reframe emotional perception of the job search. It's a career/soft-skills piece rather than a technical one, with no code, architecture, or engineering insight beyond basic self-tracking. It may resonate with engineers currently job-hunting but doesn't belong in a technical digest focused on substantive engineering content.
